audit: A.T.O.M product capability, UX and growth audit
head: d0763974e2b5b68c209fda5c680cdfd8b1bdde2a

top10.title: Make every result land and read
top10.user_problem: Runs finish off-screen and the first result looks like failure with contradictory metrics
top10.expected_impact: Every run in every workflow becomes legible; first-run trust
top10.why_now: Affects 100% of runs and the first impression; no semantics change

top10.title: Adopt any optimization solution from the working draft
top10.user_problem: Pareto alternatives cannot be applied after the default optimize path
top10.why_now: Pareto work just shipped (#96); its value is capped until alternatives are adoptable

top10.title: Result continuity on reopen
top10.user_problem: Reload shows 'Run needed' / 'UNAVAILABLE' for work that exists in history
top10.why_now: Persistence is a core promise; current state reads as data loss

top10.title: One comparison surface
top10.user_problem: Scenario comparison is unreachable with network results; comparisons split
top10.expected_impact: Documented capability returns to the main workflow

top10.title: Shareable reports and exports
top10.user_problem: UUID filenames, duplicated report sections, inline SVG, contradictory lineage
top10.expected_impact: Artifacts can be handed to another engineer

top10.title: Precise state language
top10.user_problem: Over-triggered staleness, hash labels, Version wording drift

top10.title: Candidate recommendation as a primary action
top10.why_now: Highest value per line of new code among hidden features

top10.title: Actionable errors and inline validation
top10.user_problem: Raw 'Failed to fetch', misdirected validation prompt
top10.why_now: Local-first setups hit backend errors on first run

top10.title: First-run starting point with the bundled sample
top10.why_now: Complements docs walkthrough #78 inside the product

top10.title: Measurement validation placement
top10.user_problem: Canonical calibration feature filed under Research
top10.why_now: Research issues #87–#90 will increase its importance

quick_wins.title: Fix unit capitalization in metric rows
Neutral zero-gap styling and '—' for unavailable Worst Rx
Save version: consistent label, casing and accessible name
Escape closes the project menu; expanded-aware trigger label
Replace user-facing 'tower' wording in Cell workflows; explain 'nearest 8' (nearest to the area centre) and list the selected cells
Collapse the Map key while drawing/placing; let the legend scroll without clipping
Fit Results tabs at desktop widths
Interference tool: compact summary + 'Open in Results' after analysis

opportunities.name: Results land in view
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Auto-fit to result extent (selection + radius) on a new current result unless the user panned since starting the run; keep Fit button
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Fit exists only as an icon button

opportunities.name: First-result interpretation line
opportunities.problem_solved: Users cannot tell if a result is good
opportunities.proposed_behavior: One deterministic sentence above metrics separating 'rays blocked by buildings' from 'demand buildings below threshold', neutral styling for zero gaps, '—' for unavailable worst Rx, correct unit casing
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Metrics are correct but uninterpreted and visually contradictory
opportunities.expected_product_value: Large first-run trust gain without new science
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Low: must not imply quality thresholds beyond existing ones
opportunities.github_coverage: genuinely new (#76 covered score/Pareto wording only)

opportunities.name: Adopt any optimization solution from the draft
opportunities.problem_solved: Pareto choice blocked after default path
opportunities.proposed_behavior: When the source run has no Version, offer 'Save source as Version and apply' that saves the run's retained input as a Version (input fingerprint must match) then applies; otherwise show the exact recovery step. State 'Recommended solution is already in your working draft.'
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Dialog disables both actions without guidance
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Bounded: creates a Version from retained run input; lineage must stay exact

opportunities.name: Result continuity on reopen
opportunities.proposed_behavior: On restore, show the last result's summary from Run history as HISTORICAL with 'Restore map layers (1 RF run)' and exact-input check; for saved Versions bind the run to the Version when inputs match at save time
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Run history keeps summaries, but the workspace shows 'Run needed'/'UNAVAILABLE'
opportunities.expected_product_value: Returning users trust that nothing was lost
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Rebinding must use exact fingerprints only

opportunities.name: One comparison surface
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Results → Compare always offers a source picker: current result, its baseline, any saved Version, any Pareto alternative; KPI deltas + input diff + A/B map
opportunities.expected_product_value: Restores a documented capability to the main workflow
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: None if only existing summaries are compared

opportunities.name: Candidate recommendation as a primary network action
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Add 'Find an additional cell' next to Evaluate/Optimize with inline prerequisites (2–5 cells, search area) and a dedicated Results view independent of Solutions
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Tab replaced after optimization; prerequisites conflict

opportunities.name: Shareable outputs
opportunities.problem_solved: Artifacts are hard to hand over
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Filenames '<project>-<scenario>-v<N>-<yyyymmdd>.md|html|atom-project.json'; remove duplicate report section; render map as separate SVG/PNG attachment or HTML-only; consistent lineage line
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: UUID names, duplicated tables, inline SVG

opportunities.name: Precise state language
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Separate 'view changed' (mode switch with no input change) from 'inputs changed'; human run labels ('Optimization · 8 cells · 64.4/100 · 14:39'); one Version-state vocabulary; rename auto-named scenarios by mode

opportunities.name: Actionable errors and inline validation
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Map known failures to cause+recovery (backend unreachable → URL, retry button; 500 → retry, report details); aria-invalid + inline message on invalid fields; prompt points to the field's actual tool

opportunities.name: First-run starting point
opportunities.proposed_behavior: When no saved project exists, an inline empty-state card: one sentence on what A.T.O.M does, 'Run the pre-selected sector' and 'Open sample network project' (bundled examples file), link to glossary; dismissible

opportunities.name: Measurement validation placement
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Promote CSV Measurement Validation to its own Analyze tool or a top-level Data section; rename RF Diagnostics campaign tool 'Campaign evidence (research)'
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Two similarly named surfaces; canonical action hidden
opportunities.expected_product_value: Exposes a documented capability without changing science

opportunities.name: Network Pareto trade-off chart
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Scatter of two selectable objectives with recommended/selected/inspected markers, reusing the Experiments Pareto renderer; list collapses to top-N + 'show all'
opportunities.github_coverage: partially (#76 closed by PR #96 covers explanation, not visualization)

opportunities.name: Map chrome collisions
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Auto-collapse Map key while drawing/placing; legend scroll fade; command-bar truncation rules at 1280; Results tabs fit (shorter labels or overflow menu); quieter heading focus style

opportunities.name: Optimization next to the result
opportunities.proposed_behavior: After a current network evaluation, offer 'Optimize azimuths' in the Results Optimization empty state and command-bar overflow; show active priorities summary with an edit link
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Users must know Simulate → Propagation → Advanced

opportunities.name: Accessibility fixes
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Escape closes project menu; aria-expanded-aware trigger label; label-in-name for Save version; unique names for Select cells; inventory signposted as keyboard path to cells

opportunities.name: Decision Compare with spatial delta layer
opportunities.problem_solved: Planners cannot see WHERE two plans differ
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Pick any two states (see O05); map shows a delta layer: demand buildings newly served / newly lost / overlap changed, with counts; exportable in report
opportunities.expected_product_value: Turns comparison into a spatial decision surface (Product Compass 'close the compare-to-decision loop')
implementation_surfaces: backend evaluate-network per-building served state in response or deterministic recompute
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Bounded: must use identical dataset/model fingerprints; no new physics

opportunities.name: Area-of-interest KPIs
opportunities.problem_solved: Planners care about a target district, not the whole footprint
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Reuse the drawn area as an AOI: report served demand weight, residential served, overlap and (if run) SINR serviceable share inside the AOI for the current result and comparisons
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: KPIs are network-wide only; polygon only selects cells/candidates
opportunities.expected_product_value: Answers 'does this plan cover the district?'
implementation_surfaces: backend aggregation filter by polygon (bounded vertices exist)
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Bounded: aggregation of existing per-building results; no new model

opportunities.name: Multi-sector site template
opportunities.problem_solved: Placing a 3-sector site takes 3 placements + edits
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Place a site template: N co-located Cells (default 3 at 0/120/240°) sharing position and editable as a group; still N Cells in requests
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Manual per-Cell placement; site concept exists only in glossary
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Bounded: grouping only; must not imply physical site feasibility (glossary)

opportunities.name: Review package export
opportunities.user_workflow: Hand a decision to a colleague
opportunities.proposed_behavior: One action exports a zip: HTML report, Markdown, project file, map PNG and a manifest (hashes, dataset/model identity, limitations)
implementation_surfaces: zip writer (no new dependency or tiny one)

opportunities.name: Undo/redo for plan edits
opportunities.problem_solved: Edits to cells/settings are irreversible except via Versions
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Bounded in-session undo stack for inventory and setup edits

opportunities.name: Network-scope experiments
opportunities.problem_solved: Experiments sweep only the active cell
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Sweep a shared parameter across selected cells within the job cap
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Single-cell only, not stated in Network mode

opportunities.name: Calibrated or confidence-weighted predictions
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Per-area confidence from measurements

opportunities.name: Tilt/power/site-selection optimization
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Extend search space
opportunities.semantic_scientific_risk: Changes optimization semantics and request budget; needs validation

opportunities.name: Guided multi-step wizard
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Modal tour
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: Product already has a clear primary action

opportunities.name: Cost/backhaul/equity scoring
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Score candidates by cost

opportunities.name: Cloud sharing/collaboration
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Hosted projects

opportunities.name: Command palette
opportunities.proposed_behavior: Global palette
opportunities.why_current_insufficient: 14 tools in 4 stages is navigable; Concept 7F/8A reached same conclusion

opportunities.name: 3D city view
opportunities.proposed_behavior: 3D buildings/rays
